## How it was made

- Run on 2026-10-18 from 22:22:08 to 22:23:19 UTC (wall clock from the run's command log). ULog info field `boot_time_utc_us` is 1792362134531238. The log is `<rootfs>/log/2026-10-18/22_22_19.ulg`, the only `.ulg` in the rootfs, copied unchanged.
- This is the second run of the scenario. The first run, with an earlier version of the script that started no heartbeat sender, did not pass the preflight checks (`Preflight Fail: No connection to the GCS`, see "Ground station heartbeat") and was stopped before arming. It left no log, and its command and console logs were overwritten by this run, so nothing of it is kept.
- Fresh, empty rootfs: the driver script deletes and recreates it, and the px4 console shows the parameter defaults being applied (`SYS_AUTOCONFIG: curr: 0 -> new: 1`, `SYS_AUTOSTART: curr: 0 -> new: 4005`).
- `<work>` below is the working directory of the generating machine (written `/path/to/work` in the script copies), and `<PX4>` is `<work>/px4/PX4-Autopilot-v1.17.0`.
- Invocation: `bash gz_x500_vision_hover.sh <work>/gz/rootfs_B gz_x500_vision_hover` (script below). The script exports `PATH=$PATH:<work>/gz/env/bin`, `HEADLESS=1` and `GZ_IP=127.0.0.1`, sources the build's `build/px4_sitl_gz/rootfs/gz_env.sh` (it sets `GZ_SIM_RESOURCE_PATH`, `GZ_SIM_SYSTEM_PLUGIN_PATH` and `GZ_SIM_SERVER_CONFIG_PATH` to the PX4 tree's models, worlds, built gz plugins and `src/modules/simulation/gz_bridge/server.config`), and then, from inside the rootfs, runs `PX4_SIM_MODEL=gz_x500_vision <PX4>/build/px4_sitl_gz/bin/px4 -d <PX4>/build/px4_sitl_gz/etc`. Five seconds later it starts `python3 -I gcs_heartbeat.py 18570 &` (script below) and stops it after the disarm.
- PX4 starts the Gazebo server itself: v1.17.0 `ROMFS/px4fmu_common/init.d-posix/px4-rc.gzsim:50` runs `gz sim --verbose=1 -r -s <PX4>/Tools/simulation/gz/worlds/default.sdf`, and `ROMFS/px4fmu_common/init.d-posix/px4-rc.gzsim:52` starts the GUI only when `HEADLESS` is empty. No display server was started. The console shows `Gazebo simulator 8.10.0`, `gz_bridge] world: default, model: x500_vision_0` and `lockstep_scheduler] setting initial absolute time to 4216000 us`: PX4 time follows the Gazebo clock, so the boot times below are simulation time.
- The console also shows `Failed to load system plugin [libOpticalFlowSystem.so]` and `[libGstCameraSystem.so]`, which v1.17.0 `src/modules/simulation/gz_bridge/server.config:16-17` load for every world. Those two plugins were not built (see "Build"); the x500_vision model has no camera or optical flow sensor.
- Commands were sent with the px4 client binaries (`px4-param`, `px4-commander`, `px4-logger`, `px4-shutdown`), and each step was confirmed by polling `px4-listener`. Every flight command is therefore an internal command (source 1/1, `from_external` 0).
- Host: Linux x86_64. Load average (from `/proc/loadavg` in the command log) 2.11 at start, 4.02 at end. Between the arm and land commands 39.8 s of wall time passed for 39.0 s of simulation time ("sim t" as printed). pyulog reports 0 dropouts.
- Cleanup: the heartbeat sender was killed after `logger status`, px4 exited 0 after `shutdown` (`closed logfile, bytes written: 15797162`), and the script then found and killed the Gazebo server (`gz sim --verbose=1 -r -s ...`) before copying the closed log.

### Where the vision topic comes from

- The model includes `x500` and adds Gazebo's `gz::sim::systems::OdometryPublisher` plugin with `<dimensions>3</dimensions>` (v1.17.0 `Tools/simulation/gz/models/x500_vision/model.sdf:7-11`).
- `gz_bridge` subscribes to `/model/<model name>/odometry_with_covariance` when `SIM_GZ_EN_ODOM` is set (`src/modules/simulation/gz_bridge/GZBridge.cpp:123-127` and `src/modules/simulation/gz_bridge/GZBridge.cpp:241-247`; `SIM_GZ_EN_ODOM` defaults to 1 at `src/modules/simulation/gz_bridge/parameters.c:96`, and it is 1 in this log). `GZBridge::odometryCallback()` (`src/modules/simulation/gz_bridge/GZBridge.cpp:590`) converts the pose to NED and FRD and publishes it to `vehicle_visual_odometry` (`src/modules/simulation/gz_bridge/GZBridge.cpp:646`; the publication is declared at `src/modules/simulation/gz_bridge/GZBridge.hpp:156`).
- In this log every message has `pose_frame` 1 (NED), `velocity_frame` 3 (body FRD), `reset_counter` 0 and `quality` 0. Logged intervals are 20 to 40 ms.
- Logging: `SDLOG_PROFILE` is 131 (bits 0 default, 1 estimator replay, 7 computer vision and avoidance; set by `ROMFS/px4fmu_common/init.d-posix/rcS:182`, bit names at `src/modules/logger/module.yaml:89-96`). The estimator replay set adds `vehicle_visual_odometry` (`src/modules/logger/logged_topics.cpp:318`), and the vision set adds it again with a 30 ms interval (`src/modules/logger/logged_topics.cpp:346`), which only updates the interval of the existing subscription (`src/modules/logger/logged_topics.cpp:491-496`).
- Not fused: `EKF2_EV_CTRL` is 0, its default (`src/modules/ekf2/params_external_vision.yaml:16`); neither airframe file nor the SITL `rcS` sets it. In the log, `estimator_aid_src_ev_pos`, `estimator_aid_src_ev_hgt` and `estimator_aid_src_ev_yaw` (2525 messages each) have `fused` 0 in every message, and `estimator_status_flags.cs_ev_pos`, `cs_ev_hgt`, `cs_ev_vel` and `cs_ev_yaw` are 0 in every message.

### Ground station heartbeat

`ROMFS/px4fmu_common/init.d-posix/airframes/4001_gz_x500:51` sets `NAV_DLL_ACT` 2 (Return mode, `src/modules/commander/commander_params.c:589`). With `NAV_DLL_ACT` above 0 a missing ground station link is an arming check failure for every mode (`src/modules/commander/HealthAndArmingChecks/checks/rcAndDataLinkCheck.cpp:80-97`, message `Preflight Fail: No connection to the GCS`, which this run's console shows once before the heartbeat arrived). To keep every parameter at its airframe default, the run used `gcs_heartbeat.py` (28 lines, Python standard library only, below): a MAVLink 1 HEARTBEAT at 1 Hz from system 255, component 190, with type 6 (`MAV_TYPE_GCS`), autopilot 8 (`MAV_AUTOPILOT_INVALID`), base_mode 0 and system status 4 (`MAV_STATE_ACTIVE`), sent to UDP 127.0.0.1:18570, the GCS link of PX4 instance 0 (`ROMFS/px4fmu_common/init.d-posix/px4-rc.mavlink:11` and `ROMFS/px4fmu_common/init.d-posix/px4-rc.mavlink:14`). It reads and discards what PX4 sends back and sends nothing else. PX4 logged `[mavlink] partner IP: 127.0.0.1` at 5.736 s, and `failsafe_flags.gcs_connection_lost` turned false at 5.744 s.

### Build

The same build as `gz_quadtailsitter_transition.ulg`: `build/px4_sitl_gz/bin/px4`, 59312824 bytes, SHA-256 `e5a61fed34857c01e5c28235c3dc5c0c7a66d4ac044dd0ef133d10705cfd68d9`, file time 22:09:11 UTC, before this run. The PX4 tree is the v1.17.0 checkout used for the other v1.17.0 golden logs; `git status` lists no modified file (six board support files for a non-SITL hardware target are missing from the checkout and are not part of this build).

Gazebo came from conda-forge only, installed with micromamba 2.0.5 (the conda-forge package `micromamba-2.0.5-0.tar.bz2`, SHA-256 `bfc2e3a414d651af7508c49998a12b5cf3c7029d56c5ef37c9a3248cd7faef78`):

```bash
MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX=<work>/gz/mroot micromamba create -y -p <work>/gz/env -c conda-forge --override-channels \
    --ssl-verify <CA bundle of the host's HTTPS proxy> \
    libgz-sim8 libgz-transport13 libgz-sensors8 libgz-plugin2 libgz-msgs10 gz-tools2 libopencv
micromamba clean -a -y
gz sim --versions    # 8.10.0
```

Resolved versions that matter (from `micromamba list` of that environment): libgz-sim8 8.10.0 (build py314h484a5df_3), libgz-transport13 13.5.0, libgz-sensors8 8.2.2, libgz-plugin2 2.0.4, libgz-msgs10 10.3.2, libgz-physics7 7.5.0, libgz-rendering8 8.2.2, libgz-gui8 8.4.0, libgz-common5 5.7.1, libgz-math7 7.7.0, libgz-utils2 2.2.1, libgz-fuel-tools9 9.1.1, libsdformat14 14.8.0, gz-tools2 2.0.3, ogre-next 2.3.3, ogre 1.10.12.1, dartsim-cpp 6.19.5, libprotobuf 7.35.1, libabseil 20260526.0, libopencv 5.0.0, qt6-main 6.12.0, ruby 3.4.2, libstdcxx 16.2.0, python 3.14.8 (the environment's own Python; PX4 and the scripts used the system Python 3.13.16 at `/usr/bin/python3`, because the environment's `bin` was appended to `PATH`).

PX4 build commands:

```bash
cmake -S <PX4> -B <PX4>/build/px4_sitl_gz -G Ninja -DCONFIG=px4_sitl_default -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo \
    -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=<work>/gz/env -DPYTHON_EXECUTABLE=/usr/bin/python3 -DPython3_EXECUTABLE=/usr/bin/python3 \
    -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=<work>/gz/tools/cxx_launcher.sh
CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=<work>/gz/env ninja -k 0 -C <PX4>/build/px4_sitl_gz
```

- The compiler launcher `cxx_launcher.sh` (below) is needed because conda-forge abseil and protobuf require C++17 while PX4 v1.17.0 compiles with `-std=gnu++14`. For sources under `src/modules/simulation/gz_*` only, it replaces `-std=gnu++14` with `-std=gnu++17` and adds `-Wno-error=deprecated-declarations` (protobuf deprecates `RepeatedField::Resize(int, const T&)`, which v1.17.0 `src/modules/simulation/gz_bridge/GZMixingInterfaceESC.cpp:81` and `src/modules/simulation/gz_bridge/GZMixingInterfaceWheel.cpp:79` call). For every source it turns `-I<work>/gz/env/include` into `-isystem`. No PX4 source file was changed.
- `-k 0` lets ninja finish everything else when a target fails. Two optional targets failed and were not built: the external OpticalFlow project (`opencv2/core/types_c.h` and `cv::undistortPoints` are gone in OpenCV 5.0.0), and `libGstCameraSystem.so` (the link cannot find `-lgstreamer-1.0`).
- The build was incremental: five ninja runs between 22:04 and 22:09 UTC while the setup was being fixed, with the launcher's last edit (file time 22:09:00 UTC) before the fifth run. A clean build with the final launcher was not run. `gz_quadtailsitter_transition.provenance.md` gives the details.

## Parameters

No parameter was set by the script. The logged parameter changes (pyulog `changed_parameters`, 4) are written by PX4 itself on the ground: `EKF2_MAG_DECL` 3.4057650566101074 at 5.444 s (log start, same value as the initial one), and `CAL_BARO0_ID` 6619404, `CAL_BARO0_OFF` 2.44140625, `CAL_BARO0_PRIO` 50 at 9.556 s. pyulog counts 1003 initial parameters.

Values at log start (pyulog `initial_parameters`; the `param show` lines in the command log print the same): `SYS_AUTOSTART` 4005, `MAV_TYPE` 2, `MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT` 2.5, `NAV_DLL_ACT` 2, `EKF2_EV_CTRL` 0, `EKF2_GPS_CTRL` 7, `EKF2_HGT_REF` 1, `SIM_GZ_EN_ODOM` 1, `COM_DISARM_LAND` 2.0, `SDLOG_MODE` 1, `SDLOG_PROFILE` 131. `VT_TYPE` is not in the log: the logger writes only parameters in use, and no VTOL module runs on this airframe.

## Observed sequence

Boot times are the ULog `timestamp` field (microseconds since boot) divided by 1e6. Enum names are from v1.17.0: arming_state 1 DISARMED, 2 ARMED (`msg/versioned/VehicleStatus.msg:11-12`); nav_state 4 AUTO_LOITER (`msg/versioned/VehicleStatus.msg:40`), 17 AUTO_TAKEOFF and 18 AUTO_LAND (`msg/versioned/VehicleStatus.msg:53-54`). `latest_disarming_reason` 6 is `auto_disarm_land` (`build/px4_sitl_gz/events/events_generated.h:170`).

### vehicle_status (109 messages, 5.192 s to 55.520 s), every change of the listed fields

| boot time | arming_state | nav_state | failsafe | vehicle_type | pre_flight_checks_pass | latest_disarming_reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5.192 s | 1 DISARMED | 4 AUTO_LOITER | false | 1 ROTARY_WING | false | 0 |
| 7.364 s | 1 | 4 | false | 1 | **true** | 0 |
| 8.480 s | **2 ARMED** | 4 | false | 1 | true | 0 |
| 11.576 s | 2 | **17 AUTO_TAKEOFF** | false | 1 | true | 0 |
| 17.684 s | 2 | **4 AUTO_LOITER** | false | 1 | true | 0 |
| 47.684 s | 2 | **18 AUTO_LAND** | false | 1 | true | 0 |
| 55.016 s | **1 DISARMED** | 4 | false | 1 | true | **6** |

`system_id` is 1 in every row; `is_vtol` is false; `in_transition_mode` is never true. `latest_arming_reason` goes from 0 to 3 (command_internal) at 8.480 s. Armed 46.536 s (8.480 s to 55.016 s); AUTO_LOITER 30.000 s (17.684 s to 47.684 s).

### Other topics

- `vehicle_land_detected.landed` (58 messages): true at 5.188 s, false at 12.324 s, true at 53.000 s.
- Height above the local origin (`-vehicle_local_position.z`) in AUTO_LOITER: 1.69 m when AUTO_LOITER started (the vehicle was still climbing) up to 2.49 m.
- `vehicle_command` (8 rows): 211 DO_GRIPPER at 4.920 s (source 132/34432, target 163/122, confirmation 85, param2 1.0; see "Boot-time DO_GRIPPER" below); 400 (p1 1) at 8.476 s; 22 at 11.556 s; 400 at 11.568 s; 21 at 47.668 s; 1001, 1000, 1001 (gimbal manager, target 1/0) at 47.936 s, sent internally after the switch to AUTO_LAND. Every row except the first has source 1/1; all have `from_external` 0.
- `vehicle_command_ack` (6 rows): 211 result 5 (IN_PROGRESS, result_param1 255) at 4.924 s and result 0 at 6.020 s, both to 132/128; 400 result 0 at 8.480 s; 22 result 0 at 11.564 s; 400 result 0 at 11.576 s; 21 result 0 at 47.672 s.
- `failsafe_flags` (96 messages, 5.348 s to 55.556 s), fields that are ever true (`mode_req_*` not listed): `gcs_connection_lost` from 5.348 s to 5.744 s (until the first heartbeat); `local_position_invalid`, `local_position_invalid_relaxed`, `local_velocity_invalid`, `global_position_invalid` and `global_position_invalid_relaxed` from 5.348 s to 7.364 s (before the estimator had a position); `auto_mission_missing`, `offboard_control_signal_lost` and `manual_control_signal_lost` in every message (headless, no RC, no offboard source, no mission). `vehicle_status.failsafe` is never true.

### Boot-time DO_GRIPPER

The first `vehicle_command` row is published by `payload_deliverer` at start-up, not by the script. `PayloadDeliverer::send_gripper_vehicle_command()` declares `vehicle_command_s vcmd;` without initializing it and sets only `timestamp`, `command` (211) and `param2` (1 = grab) (v1.17.0 `src/modules/payload_deliverer/payload_deliverer.cpp:239-244`; called at `src/modules/payload_deliverer/payload_deliverer.cpp:72`). Source, target, the other params and `confirmation` are whatever the stack held. Its acks go to that source system with the source component truncated to 8 bits (`src/modules/payload_deliverer/payload_deliverer.cpp:248`, `uint8_t target_component`): 34432 is 0x8680, so the acks go to 132/128. The ids differ from boot to boot (194/17676 in `gz_quadtailsitter_transition.ulg` and 8/17020 in `payload_two_sources.ulg`, in the same directory).

## Logged messages

All 17 'L' (logged string) messages were read with the pyulog API. There are no tagged 'L' messages, and all 17 have log_level 54 (INFO): none is at WARNING or above. `ulog_messages` (which also decodes events) shows nothing above INFO either. Its INFO lines include `Armed by internal command` 0:00:08.480, `Using default takeoff altitude: 2.50 m` 0:00:11.576, `Takeoff detected` 0:00:12.332, `Landing at current position` 0:00:47.672, `Landing detected` 0:00:53.012, `Disarmed by landing` 0:00:55.016. The px4 console shows three boot-time preflight warnings (`ekf2 missing data`, `system power unavailable`, `No connection to the GCS`) printed before the logger started at 5.444 s, so they are not in the log.

## Extraction commands

Run in `testdata/sitl/v1.17.0` with pyulog 1.2.4, with `facts.py`, `x500_extras.py` and `rawcount.py` (below) saved outside `testdata`:

```bash
sha256sum gz_x500_vision_hover.ulg; stat -c '%s bytes' gz_x500_vision_hover.ulg
python3 -I /usr/local/bin/ulog_info gz_x500_vision_hover.ulg
python3 -I /usr/local/bin/ulog_messages gz_x500_vision_hover.ulg
python3 -I facts.py gz_x500_vision_hover.ulg SYS_AUTOSTART MAV_TYPE MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT SDLOG_MODE SDLOG_PROFILE NAV_DLL_ACT \
    EKF2_EV_CTRL EKF2_GPS_CTRL EKF2_HGT_REF SIM_GZ_EN_ODOM COM_DISARM_LAND VT_TYPE
python3 -I x500_extras.py gz_x500_vision_hover.ulg
python3 -I rawcount.py gz_x500_vision_hover.ulg
```

`facts.py` (the same file as in the other two provenance files of this change):

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""facts.py <log.ulg> [PARAM ...]: print the log facts quoted in a provenance file (pyulog 1.2.4).

Hash and size of the file; firmware and time info; the named parameters at log start and every
logged parameter change; every change of the listed vehicle_status, vtol_vehicle_status and
vehicle_land_detected fields; every failsafe_flags field that is ever set (mode_req_* skipped);
every vehicle_command and vehicle_command_ack row; every logged string ('L') message with its level.
Times are boot times in seconds (the ULog timestamp field divided by 1e6)."""
import hashlib
import os
import sys

from pyulog import ULog

path, wanted = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]
h = hashlib.sha256()
with open(path, 'rb') as f:
    for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b''):
        h.update(chunk)
print('sha256 %s size %d' % (h.hexdigest(), os.path.getsize(path)))
u = ULog(path)
info = u.msg_info_dict
for k in ('ver_sw', 'ver_sw_release', 'sys_toolchain_ver', 'boot_time_utc_us'):
    print('%s %s' % (k, info.get(k)))
print('start_timestamp %d last_timestamp %d dropouts %d file_corruption %s'
      % (u.start_timestamp, u.last_timestamp, len(u.dropouts), u.file_corruption))
print('initial_parameters %d changed_parameters %d' % (len(u.initial_parameters), len(u.changed_parameters)))
for n in wanted:
    print('param %s %s' % (n, u.initial_parameters.get(n, '<absent>')))
for t, n, v in u.changed_parameters:
    print('changed %.3f %s %s' % (t / 1e6, n, v))


def topic(name):
    return [d for d in u.data_list if d.name == name]


def changes(name, fields):
    for d in topic(name):
        t, prev = d.data['timestamp'], None
        print('%s multi %d: %d rows, %.3f to %.3f' % (name, d.multi_id, len(t), t[0] / 1e6, t[-1] / 1e6))
        for k in range(len(t)):
            cur = tuple(int(d.data[f][k]) for f in fields)
            if cur != prev:
                print('  %.3f %s' % (t[k] / 1e6, ' '.join('%s=%d' % p for p in zip(fields, cur))))
                prev = cur


changes('vehicle_status', ['arming_state', 'nav_state', 'failsafe', 'in_transition_mode', 'in_transition_to_fw',
                           'vehicle_type', 'pre_flight_checks_pass', 'latest_disarming_reason', 'system_id'])
changes('vtol_vehicle_status', ['vehicle_vtol_state', 'fixed_wing_system_failure'])
changes('vehicle_land_detected', ['landed'])
for d in topic('failsafe_flags'):
    t = d.data['timestamp']
    print('failsafe_flags multi %d: %d rows, %.3f to %.3f' % (d.multi_id, len(t), t[0] / 1e6, t[-1] / 1e6))
    for f, v in d.data.items():
        if f == 'timestamp' or f.startswith('mode_req_'):
            continue
        ch = ['%.3f->%d' % (t[k] / 1e6, v[k]) for k in range(len(t)) if k == 0 or v[k] != v[k - 1]]
        if len(ch) > 1 or v[0]:
            print('  %s: %s' % (f, ' '.join(ch)))
for d in topic('vehicle_command'):
    c = d.data
    print('vehicle_command multi %d: %d rows' % (d.multi_id, len(c['timestamp'])))
    for k in range(len(c['timestamp'])):
        print('  %.3f cmd=%d src=%d/%d tgt=%d/%d p1..p7=%s conf=%d ext=%d'
              % (c['timestamp'][k] / 1e6, c['command'][k], c['source_system'][k], c['source_component'][k],
                 c['target_system'][k], c['target_component'][k],
                 ','.join('%.6g' % c['param%d' % j][k] for j in range(1, 8)),
                 c['confirmation'][k], c['from_external'][k]))
for d in topic('vehicle_command_ack'):
    a = d.data
    print('vehicle_command_ack multi %d: %d rows' % (d.multi_id, len(a['timestamp'])))
    for k in range(len(a['timestamp'])):
        print('  %.3f cmd=%d result=%d result_param1=%d tgt=%d/%d ext=%d'
              % (a['timestamp'][k] / 1e6, a['command'][k], a['result'][k], a['result_param1'][k],
                 a['target_system'][k], a['target_component'][k], a['from_external'][k]))
print("'L' messages %d, tagged %d" % (len(u.logged_messages), len(u.logged_messages_tagged)))
for m in u.logged_messages:
    print('  %.3f %d %s %r' % (m.timestamp / 1e6, m.log_level, m.log_level_str(), m.message))
```

import sys
import numpy as np
from pyulog import ULog
u = ULog(sys.argv[1])
for d in [d for d in u.data_list if d.name == 'vehicle_visual_odometry']:

          % (d.multi_id, len(t), t[0] / 1e6, t[-1] / 1e6, (len(t) - 1) / ((t[-1] - t[0]) / 1e6), dt.min(), dt.max()))

for n in ('estimator_aid_src_ev_pos', 'estimator_aid_src_ev_hgt', 'estimator_aid_src_ev_yaw'):

`rawcount.py` (the same file as in `payload_two_sources.provenance.md`):

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""rawcount.py <log.ulg>: walk the ULog record headers (uint16 size, uint8 type) without pyulog, count every
record, and print the 'A' subscription and number of 'D' records of the vehicle_command, vehicle_command_ack
and vehicle_visual_odometry topics present."""
import struct
import sys

data = open(sys.argv[1], 'rb').read()
assert data[:7] == b'ULog\x01\x12\x35', data[:8]
pos, n, subs, dcount = 16, 0, {}, {}
while pos + 3 <= len(data):
    size, typ = struct.unpack_from('<HB', data, pos)
    body = data[pos + 3:pos + 3 + size]
    if len(body) < size:
        break
    n += 1
    if typ == ord('A'):
        multi, mid = struct.unpack_from('<BH', body, 0)
        subs[mid] = (body[3:].decode(), multi)
    elif typ == ord('D'):
        mid = struct.unpack_from('<H', body, 0)[0]
        dcount[mid] = dcount.get(mid, 0) + 1
    pos += 3 + size
print('records', n, 'end at', pos, 'of', len(data))
for mid, (name, multi) in sorted(subs.items()):
    if name in ('vehicle_command', 'vehicle_command_ack', 'vehicle_visual_odometry'):
        print(name, 'multi', multi, 'msg_id', mid, 'D records', dcount.get(mid, 0))
```

## The scripts that drove the flight and the build

The scripts used absolute paths under a working directory of the generating machine. In the copies below that directory is written `/path/to/work`; nothing else differs from the files that ran.

`gz_x500_vision_hover.sh` (as run: SHA-256 `f93c8c4b8712a04eb5964cdeb6944972a4d57d908ef99036ee5925b89d30e517`, 75 lines; lines 9 and 10 hold the replaced prefix):

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# gz_x500_vision_hover.sh <rootfs_dir> <scenario_name>
# Flight B: Gazebo Harmonic x500 with external vision odometry source (4005_gz_x500_vision), arm,
# takeoff (MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT default), hold position (AUTO_LOITER) ~30 s, commanded land, auto-disarm.
# vehicle_visual_odometry is published by gz_bridge from the model's OdometryPublisher.
# A minimal MAVLink GCS heartbeat (gcs_heartbeat.py) runs for the whole flight because the x500
# airframe sets NAV_DLL_ACT 2 (GCS link required to arm). Fresh rootfs, headless gz.
set -u
PX4_DIR=/path/to/work/px4/PX4-Autopilot-v1.17.0
GZ_DIR=/path/to/work/gz
BUILD=$PX4_DIR/build/px4_sitl_gz
BIN=$BUILD/bin
ETC=$BUILD/etc
OUT=$GZ_DIR/logs
ROOTFS=${1:?rootfs}; SCENARIO=${2:?scenario}
MODEL=gz_x500_vision
rm -rf "$ROOTFS"; mkdir -p "$ROOTFS" "$OUT"; cd "$ROOTFS"
PX4LOG=$OUT/$SCENARIO.px4.log; CMDLOG=$OUT/$SCENARIO.cmd.log; : > "$CMDLOG"
# Gazebo Harmonic from the conda-forge env (appended so system python3 stays first)
export PATH=$PATH:$GZ_DIR/env/bin
export HEADLESS=1 GZ_IP=127.0.0.1
set +u; . "$BUILD/rootfs/gz_env.sh"; set -u
ts() { date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3N; }
say() { echo "[$(ts)] $*" | tee -a "$CMDLOG"; }
simt() { "$BIN/px4-listener" vehicle_status 2>/dev/null | awk '/^ +timestamp:/{printf "%.3f", $2/1e6}'; }
vs() { say "STATUS: $("$BIN/px4-listener" vehicle_status 2>/dev/null | awk '/^ +(timestamp|arming_state|nav_state|failsafe|vehicle_type|in_transition_mode|in_transition_to_fw|pre_flight_checks_pass):/{gsub(/^ +/,""); printf "%s | ", $0}') VIO: $("$BIN/px4-listener" vehicle_visual_odometry 2>/dev/null | awk '/^ +(timestamp_sample|position):/{gsub(/^ +/,""); printf "%s | ", $0}') POS: $("$BIN/px4-listener" vehicle_local_position 2>/dev/null | awk '/^ +(z|vx|vy|vz):/{gsub(/^ +/,""); printf "%s | ", $0}')"; }
cmd() { say "CMD (sim t=$(simt)s): $*"; "$BIN/px4-$1" "${@:2}" 2>&1 | sed 's/^/    > /' | tee -a "$CMDLOG"; }
wait_for() { # topic field value timeout_s
  local tp=$1 f=$2 v=$3 to=$4 i=0 cur=
  while [ $i -lt "$to" ]; do
    cur=$("$BIN/px4-listener" "$tp" 2>/dev/null | awk -v f="$f" '$1==f":"{print $2}')
    if [ "$cur" = "$v" ]; then say "WAIT ok: $tp.$f=$v after ${i}s (sim t=$(simt)s)"; return 0; fi
    sleep 1; i=$((i+1))
  done
  say "WAIT TIMEOUT: $tp.$f=$cur (wanted $v) after ${to}s (sim t=$(simt)s)"; return 1
}
say "SCENARIO $SCENARIO  rootfs=$ROOTFS  PX4 $(cd $PX4_DIR && git describe --tags --always) $(cd $PX4_DIR && git rev-parse HEAD)"
say "gz: $(gz sim --versions 2>/dev/null | head -1)  host load at start: $(cat /proc/loadavg)"
touch .start_marker
say "START px4: cd $ROOTFS && . $BUILD/rootfs/gz_env.sh && HEADLESS=1 GZ_IP=127.0.0.1 PX4_SIM_MODEL=$MODEL $BIN/px4 -d $ETC > $PX4LOG 2>&1 &"
PX4_SIM_MODEL=$MODEL "$BIN/px4" -d "$ETC" > "$PX4LOG" 2>&1 &
PX4_PID=$!
sleep 5
# stand-in GCS heartbeat (4001_gz_x500 sets NAV_DLL_ACT 2, so a GCS link is a preflight requirement)
say "START gcs heartbeat: python3 -I $OUT/gcs_heartbeat.py 18570 &"
python3 -I "$OUT/gcs_heartbeat.py" 18570 &
HB_PID=$!
wait_for vehicle_status pre_flight_checks_pass True 180
wait_for home_position valid_hpos True 60
cmd param show SYS_AUTOSTART; cmd param show MAV_TYPE; cmd param show MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT; cmd param show EKF2_EV_CTRL; cmd param show EKF2_GPS_CTRL; cmd param show EKF2_HGT_REF
vs
cmd commander arm
sleep 3; vs
cmd commander takeoff
wait_for vehicle_status nav_state 17 10; vs
wait_for vehicle_status nav_state 4 120; vs
sleep 10; vs
sleep 10; vs
sleep 10; vs
cmd commander land
wait_for vehicle_status nav_state 18 10; vs
wait_for vehicle_status arming_state 1 240; vs
sleep 6
cmd logger status
kill $HB_PID; say "stopped gcs heartbeat"
cmd shutdown
wait $PX4_PID; say "px4 exit=$?"
sleep 2
say "remaining gz processes: $(pgrep -af 'gz sim --verbose' | tr '\n' ';')"
pkill -f 'gz sim --verbose' && say "killed gz sim server"
ULG=$(find log -name '*.ulg' -newer .start_marker | sort | tail -1)
cp "$ULG" "$OUT/$SCENARIO.ulg"; cp "$0" "$OUT/$SCENARIO.sh" 2>/dev/null
say "COPIED $ROOTFS/$ULG -> $OUT/$SCENARIO.ulg ($(stat -c %s "$OUT/$SCENARIO.ulg") bytes)"
say "host load at end: $(cat /proc/loadavg)"
say "DONE"
```

`gcs_heartbeat.py` (unchanged, SHA-256 `1aae3108f327daf40fea81f408094143c5616a39174a4a690f463f7ede40bfe8`, 28 lines; "MISSIONPLANNER" in its comment is the MAVLink name of component id 190, `MAV_COMP_ID_MISSIONPLANNER`):

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Minimal stand-in GCS: sends a MAVLink v1 HEARTBEAT (MAV_TYPE_GCS) at 1 Hz to PX4 SITL's
GCS MAVLink instance (UDP 127.0.0.1:18570 for px4 instance 0). Needed because 4001_gz_x500
sets NAV_DLL_ACT 2, which makes "No connection to the GCS" a preflight failure; this keeps the
airframe's default parameters untouched. Usage: gcs_heartbeat.py [port] [duration_s]"""
import socket, struct, sys, time
port = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 18570
dur = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 3600
def x25(data, crc=0xFFFF):
    for b in data:
        tmp = b ^ (crc & 0xFF); tmp = (tmp ^ (tmp << 4)) & 0xFF
        crc = ((crc >> 8) ^ (tmp << 8) ^ (tmp << 3) ^ (tmp >> 4)) & 0xFFFF
    return crc
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
s.setblocking(False)
seq = 0; t0 = time.time()
while time.time() - t0 < dur:
    payload = struct.pack("<IBBBBB", 0, 6, 8, 0, 4, 3)  # custom_mode, type=GCS, autopilot=INVALID, base_mode, status=ACTIVE, mavlink_version
    hdr = struct.pack("<BBBBB", len(payload), seq & 0xFF, 255, 190, 0)  # len, seq, sysid 255, compid 190 (MISSIONPLANNER), msgid 0
    crc = x25(hdr + payload + bytes([50]))  # CRC_EXTRA for HEARTBEAT = 50
    s.sendto(b"\xfe" + hdr + payload + struct.pack("<H", crc), ("127.0.0.1", port))
    seq += 1
    try:
        while True: s.recv(4096)  # drain PX4 replies
    except BlockingIOError:
        pass
    time.sleep(1.0)
```

`cxx_launcher.sh`, the compiler launcher of the PX4 build (as used: SHA-256 `5c0f648bb6db3933130b9cbb968a9f3453b2fd68df3f8e1e3809b86aa65d47f1`, 20 lines; line 9 holds the replaced prefix):

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Compiler launcher for the PX4 gz build against conda-forge Gazebo Harmonic.
# conda-forge abseil/protobuf require C++17, PX4 v1.17 builds with -std=gnu++14.
# For gz simulation sources only, swap -std=gnu++14 -> -std=gnu++17.
# For all sources, treat the conda env include dir as a system include dir (-isystem)
# so -Werror is not applied to third-party headers.
# For gz sources also add -Wno-error=deprecated-declarations (protobuf 35 deprecates
# RepeatedField::Resize(int, const T&), used by gz_bridge; a warning only).
GZENV=/path/to/work/gz/env
args=("$@")
gz=0
case "$*" in *"/modules/simulation/gz_"*) gz=1 ;; esac
out=()
for a in "${args[@]}"; do
  if [ $gz = 1 ] && [ "$a" = "-std=gnu++14" ]; then out+=("-std=gnu++17")
  elif [ "$a" = "-I$GZENV/include" ]; then out+=("-isystem" "$GZENV/include")
  else out+=("$a"); fi
done
[ $gz = 1 ] && out+=("-Wno-error=deprecated-declarations")
exec "${out[@]}"
```
